title: SEA-HELM: Southeast Asian Holistic Evaluation of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using the KALAHI dataset, which consists of prompts representing culturally-specific situations for Filipino people. The evaluation measures whether the language model provides culturally-relevant (helpful and harmless within the local context) responses versus culturally-irrelevant or stereotypical responses.

Assessing the performance disparities and representation gaps of large language models in mid- to low-resource Southeast Asian languages compared to high-resource languages. This is done using native-language prompts, human-translated benchmark tasks, and the LINDSEA dataset for fine-grained linguistic diagnostics.
